exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const out=[];S.traverse(o=>{if(o.name!=='main:deskTop')return;o.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);const p=o.geometry.attributes.position;const v=new T.Vector3();let n=0,acc=[0,0,0];const seen=new Set();for(let i=0;i<p.count;i+=3){v.fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);const key=v.x.toFixed(0)+','+v.z.toFixed(0);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);acc[0]+=v.x;acc[1]+=v.y;acc[2]+=v.z;n++;if(n<=6)out.push([+v.x.toFixed(1),+v.y.toFixed(1),+v.z.toFixed(1)]);}return JSON.stringify({distinct:n,first6:out})})()
